meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via the selected gateway. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Codex 接入为编码代理,可与 Claude 并存或互相替换
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 Codex 和 Claude 同时当编码代理,并能按分组自由切换。
copy.tagline_en: Plug Codex in as a coding agent you can run beside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex and Claude as interchangeable coding agents per group.

howto.what: 装上后 Codex 可成为某个群组的 agent 后端：它自己负责规划、编排工具与 MCP 工具、在服务端保存会话历史并支持会话续接。凭据只存在 OneCLI vault 中，容器里读不到真实密钥。
howto.when: 当你在主机上对某个群组执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 并重启，或把新群组的默认后端设为 codex 之后，该群组的消息就由 Codex 处理。

say.text: 帮我把这个群组的后端切换成 Codex
say.note: 会改该群组 provider 并重启，由你确认群组 id

say.text: 给 Codex 授权，用我的 ChatGPT 订阅登录
把新建群组的默认后端改成 codex

howto.what_en: Installed, Codex can serve as a group's agent backend: it does the planning, tool and MCP orchestration, server-side history and session resume. Credentials stay in the OneCLI vault; the container never reads the real key.
howto.when_en: After you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` on the host and restart that group, or set codex as the default for new groups, its messages are handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Switch this group's backend to Codex
say_en.note: Updates the group's provider and restarts it

say_en.text: Authorize Codex with my ChatGPT subscription
say_en.note: Runs the provider-auth codex vault walk-through

say_en.text: Make codex the default backend for new groups
say_en.note: Sets DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER; affects only groups created after
